header:
A = the byte (0x0EFE) bytes past directory entry IZ's song position (block word 0x3460[IZ], offset byte 0x3482[IZ]); W = 0. When offset + N passes 0xFF it reads offset 5 of the +3 next block (right only when it lands exactly on 0x100), W = 0xFF at the chain end.
BStore_ReadByteAtSongPositionPlus1 calls it with (0x0EFE) = 1, the unlabelled 0xF6B8FB with 2. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159744 `ldw (3838:16), 1` -- BStore_ReadByteAtSongPositionPlus1 sets the offset N = 1 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159745 `calr sub_F6B905` -- ... and calls it (caller site)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159760 `ldw (3838:16), 2` -- the other caller (0xF6B8FB) sets N = 2
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159791 `m_add_rm MW16, 0x0efe, 5` -- offset byte 0x3482[IZ] + (0x0EFE)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159792 `cp iy, 255` -- inside the block?
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159794 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_HL, ra_IY, 1` -- A = byte at block + offset + N
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159797 `ld iy, (xhl+3)` -- else follow the +3 next-block link
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159803 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_HL, ra_IY, 1` -- A = byte at offset 5 of the next block (IY = 5)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159806 `ld w, 255:opc` -- W = 0xFF when the link is 0xFFFF

header:
Third copy of BStore_FreeChain (after BStore_FreeChain_B): (0x0C88) := WA (block limit), BStore_FreeHead := IY, walks the chain from block IY clearing bit 7 and writing 0x82 at +5, splices the old head after the last block and adds the count to BStore_FreeCount; seeks through BStore_SetCursorBlockAddrFromIY instead of BStore_SeekBlock_Alloc.
BStore_TruncateAfterSongPosition frees the blocks after the new end with WA = BStore_BlockCount; 0xF6B73C frees one (WA = 1). Basis: body compared with BStore_FreeChain (67 = 67 instructions, only seek-call order and push width differ) + callers.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:158664 `calr sub_F6BAFA` -- BStore_TruncateAfterSongPosition: free everything after the truncation block (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:158663 `ld wa, (BStore_BlockCount:16)` -- limit = the whole heap
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:159447 `calr sub_F6BAFA` -- second caller (unnamed 0xF6B657 path) with WA = 1
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:160082 `ld bc, (BStore_FreeHead:24)` -- old free-list head saved ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:160083 `ld (BStore_FreeHead:24), iy` -- ... and the chain becomes the new head
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:160106 `ld (xhl+5), 130` -- freed block gets 0x82 at +5, as in BStore_FreeChain 0xF7A58F
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:160136 `add (BStore_FreeCount:24), wa` -- count added to the free count
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:188724 `BStore_FreeChain:` -- the twin; instruction-by-instruction compare (cmpbody.py in agent_v scratch) differs only at the seek calls and push IY vs push XIY

header:

First half of StepRecord_RestoreCursorFromSlot (and of the unlabelled 0xF6C2F4 variant, which then reads rec+3 into (0x0E53)); StepRecord_SaveCursorToSlot writes the same fields. Basis: callers + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:161076 `calr sub_F6C30A` -- the 0xF6C2F4 variant ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:161077 `ld a, (xhl+3)` -- ... reads rec+3 through the XHL it leaves
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:161102 `add xwa, 3857` -- record base 0x0F11 + 8*(A&7)

header:

MsgLine_ControlTypeAndValue calls it for control type 1, the 'P.BEND=' caption. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:164998 `ld w, (4843:16)` -- MSB 7 bits from (0x12EB)

header:
Copies the event at the step-record scan position (block (0x0FD4), offset (0x0FD6)) into the buffer at 0x0FC7: a 0x81 beat mark or 0x82 end alone, otherwise the lead byte and the data bytes up to the next byte with bit 7, advancing past each (next block via +3, offset 5).
The target of StepRecord_ReadScanEvent_Veneer, whose header describes it. Basis: caller (veneer) + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168103 `ld xix, 4039` -- buffer 0x0FC7
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168106 `cp a, 129` -- 0x81 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168108 `cp a, 130` -- ... or 0x82: one byte only
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168116 `bit 7, a` -- stop at the next lead byte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168143 `ld hl, (4052:16)` -- sub_F6E9E6 reads at block (0x0FD4) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168146 `ld ix, (4054:16)` -- ... offset (0x0FD6)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:168184 `ldw wa, 5` -- sub_F6EA15 advances; past 0xFF -> next block offset 5

The target of MidiFileL0ad_LcdKeyRow1 (`jp`); load-side twin of MidiFileSave_WriteSeqBankSmf's body. Basis: caller + body + twin.

The body behind MidiFileSave_WriteSeqBankSmf (`jp`), whose header describes it; save-side twin of MidiFileL0ad_SelectSeqBankAndReadSmf. Basis: caller + body.

header:
Byte +0xC6 of the current bank's 0xC00-byte copy (0x610000 + BStore_CurrentBank*0xC00) := C -- the bank-copy twin of the song's GM flag 0x6034C6.
Smf_ReadFile calls it right after setting (0x6034C6) and GM mode (0x7F4D) bit 2 to the same 0 / 0xFF. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:169570 `ld (6304966:24), 255` -- ... or 0xFF with C = 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:169572 `calr sub_F6F8A5` -- then calls it (caller)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142808 `stores it as the song's GM flag (0x6034C6) = 0xFF / 0` -- an existing header: the established meaning of workspace +0xC6

header:
In all 16 channels' 64-byte part records at 0x6036A0 (records 0-7 and 9-16, record 8 skipped as in SmfPart_RecordOffsets): +0x0D := 2 and +0x0C := 0x80 -- the fields the SMF writer exports as RPN 0 (pitch-bend sensitivity, CC 6) and RPN 1 (fine tuning, CC 6/38 = +0x0C>>1, bit 0<<6).
Smf_ReadFile runs it on its success path after the import. Basis: caller + body + the writer's reads of the same fields.

Smf_ReadFile's first call, before any event is read. Basis: caller + body + the arrays' readers (SmfCC_UpdateSelectedRpn, SmfCC_PutSelectedRpnValueEvent, SmfCC_CombineFineTuneDataEntry).

header:
For directory entries 0..16 ((0x349F) counting), while at least 17 blocks are free: allocates a block (T_BStore_AllocBlock_Veneer), marks it used with no links (+1 := 0, +3 := 0xFFFF), sets the entry's in-use bit and head, and points the entry's song position (0x3460 / 0x3482) at its offset 5.
Smf_ReadFile runs it after clearing the bank, before reading events; sub_F73566 is a copy (Smf_ReadMultiTrack's split pass). Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:169897 `mx_ld_mi16 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IY, 0x0005` -- ... offset 0x3482[n] := 5
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:169901 `inc 1, (13471:16)` -- 17 entries

header:
At master track 17's cursor (index 16) writes the tag-0x87 time-signature record {0x87, 0x00, 0x03} (Data_F6FAB4: beats per bar = 3+1 = 4, as BStore_TimeSigFirstMeasure reads it), marks the master track used ((0x360E) bit 0) and saves the cursor; stops if a byte store fails ((0x1238)).
Called by Smf_ReadFile and by sub_F72F5C (the multi-track split) before any event is stored. Basis: callers + body + the tag-0x87 reader.

header:
For each of the 17 directory entries in use (0x603500[3n] bit 7): loads track n's cursor, writes the 0x82 end tag there and saves that position as the track's end cursor (0x6034A0[n] / 0x60347E[n], via sub_F6FB16).
Smf_ReadFile runs it at the file's End of Track ((0x10CB) = 0xFF, set by SmfEvent_Meta on meta 0x2F). Basis: caller + body.

Smf_ReadFile runs it at End of Track, after Smf_TerminateUsedTracks. Basis: caller + body + T_F40A04's target.

header:
SmfCC_PutParamEventWithNumber with the number fixed at 0xB5: unless (0x11AE) = 0xFF, stores {0xB4, tick (Smf_TicksToPpq96), 0x35, (0x11AE), (0x11AF)&0x7F, (0x11B0)} in the event channel's track (multi-track: slot Smf_ClampTrackToSlot((0x11B2))), marks the channel and saves the cursor.
Only SmfCC_Sustain (CC 64) calls it, with (0x11AE) = ByteMap_F7091E[ch], (0x11AF) = the pedal value, (0x11B0) = 0x7F. Basis: caller + body + sibling.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:171940 `ld (4527:16), a` -- SmfCC_Sustain: (0x11AF) := the CC value ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:171942 `calr sub_F7083B` -- ... then this (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:171994 `or a, 4` -- lead 0xB0|4 = what SmfCC_PutParamEventWithNumber writes when its number has bit 7
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172016 `ld a, 181:opc` -- number 0xB5 & 0x7F = 0x35
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172044 `call SmfEvent_MarkChannelUsed` -- channel marked
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:174507 `ld (4993:16), 184` -- the sibling's callers set 0xB8..0xBD the same way

header:
C = the selected RPN (0/1/2): stores {0xB0 (|2, |1 if (0x11AF) b7, for RPN 1 only), tick (Smf_TicksToPpq96), the channel's part (ByteMap_F70298; raw channel for multi-track), class Data_F70C3C[C] = 0x0B / 0x0A / 0x09, (0x11AF)&0x7F, 0x7F} in the channel's track, marks the channel and saves the cursor.
Only SmfCC_PutSelectedRpnValueEvent calls it, after loading the RPN's value into (0x11AF). Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172434 `cp l, 255` -- SmfCC_PutSelectedRpnValueEvent: an RPN is selected ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172444 `calr sub_F70B22` -- ... then this (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172477 `cp c, 1:i3` -- flag bits only for RPN 1
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172534 `ld xde, Data_F70C3C` -- class byte by RPN ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172593 `.byte 0x0B, 0x0A, 0x09` -- ... 0x0B / 0x0A / 0x09
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172542 `ld a, (4527:16)` -- the value
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:172549 `ld a, 127:opc` -- last byte 0x7F

header:
Writes (0x1086) 0x81 beat marks at track IY's cursor (TrackCursor_Load .. TrackCursor_Save), stopping if a byte store fails ((0x1238)); then (0x11B1) |= 1 and (0x1238) := 0.
Smf_ApplyDeltaTime calls it (4 sites) with (0x1086) = the whole quarter notes the event's delta crossed. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:173460 `ld a, 129:opc` -- 0x81 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:173463 `calr BStore_PutByteAndAdvance` -- ... appended
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:173468 `djnz16 bc, -19` -- (0x1086) times
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:173469 `calr TrackCursor_Save` -- cursor saved
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:173470 `m_or_mi8 MB16, 0x11b1, 0x01` -- (0x11B1) bit 0

header:
Multi-track import: for slot Smf_TrackToSlot((0x11B2)), while at least 17 blocks are free, allocates a block (T_BStore_AllocBlock_Veneer), marks it used with no links, sets the directory entry's in-use bit and head, and points the slot's song position (0x3460 / 0x3482) at offset 5.
Smf_ReadMultiTrack calls it before each MTrk chunk; the per-slot form of Smf_AllocFirstBlockForAllTracks. Basis: caller + body + sibling.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:174813 `calr sub_F72822` -- Smf_ReadMultiTrack, top of the per-track loop (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176587 `calr Smf_TrackToSlot` -- slot = min(track, 1)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176589 `m_cp_mi16 MW24, BStore_FreeCount, 0x0011` -- needs 17 free blocks
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176593 `call T_BStore_AllocBlock_Veneer` -- allocate
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176614 `mx_or_mi8 MXB, ra_HL, ra_IY, 0x80` -- directory entry in use, head := block
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176621 `mx_st_mr16 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IX, 0` -- song position block ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176625 `mx_ld_mi16 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IY, 0x0005` -- ... offset 5

header:
Multi-track import: if slot Smf_TrackToSlot((0x11B2))'s directory entry is in use, writes the 0x82 end tag at its cursor (BStore_LoadTrackCursor) and saves that position as the slot's end cursor 0x6034A0 / 0x60347E (sub_F728D5).
Smf_ReadTrackChunk runs it at the chunk's End of Track ((0x10CB) = 0xFF); the per-slot form of Smf_TerminateUsedTracks. Basis: caller + body + sibling.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:174959 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, 0x10cb, 0xff` -- Smf_ReadTrackChunk: End of Track ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:174966 `calr sub_F728A3` -- ... then this (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176651 `mx_bit 7, MXD, ra_DE, ra_IY` -- entry in use?
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176657 `calr BStore_LoadTrackCursor` -- slot cursor
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176658 `ld a, 130:opc` -- 0x82 written
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176689 `mx_st_mr16 MXD, ra_IX, ra_HL, 0` -- sub_F728D5: end cursor block 0x60347E[slot]

header:
Counts the used tracks (bit in (0x360C)/(0x360E) and directory entry in use); with two or more, merges every later track whose mask bit is set into the first used one: (0x0C70) = first, (0x0C71) = t, (0x0C72) = first, Smf_MergeTracks -- one track for the format-0 file.
Smf_WriteFile runs it before the sizing pass (SmfSize_Pass). Basis: caller + body + callee.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179086 `call sub_F72918` -- Smf_WriteFile, before SmfSize_Pass (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176767 `cp l, 2:i3` -- fewer than two used tracks: nothing to do
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176798 `ld (3184:16), l` -- source 1 = the first used track
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176813 `ld (3185:16), c` -- source 2 = a later used track
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176816 `ld (3186:16), a` -- destination = the first
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176819 `calr sub_F72A2B` -- the merge (Smf_MergeTracks)

header:
Merges source tracks (0x0C70) and (0x0C71) into destination (0x0C72): each 1..(0x0CA2) and the sources distinct (else BStore_ErrorCode 3); opens both chains, clears the destination (BStore_ClearTrack via T_F40A04) unless it is a source, gives it a new block and merges the two streams into it.
The SMF module's copy of TrackMerge_Execute without its part checks (error 9) and part assignment; called by Smf_MergeTrack2IntoTrack1, SmfExport_MergeUsedTracksIntoFirst and an unreferenced loop at 0xF729FE. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176858 `calr sub_F72A2B` -- Smf_MergeTrack2IntoTrack1, whose header calls it the two-source / one-destination merge (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176903 `m_cp_rm MB16, 0x0ca2, 1` -- range checks ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176918 `ld (BStore_ErrorCode:16), 3` -- ... error 3, as TrackMerge_Execute
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176925 `call T_BStore_OpenChain_Call` -- source 1 chain
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176933 `call T_BStore_OpenChain_Call` -- source 2 chain
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176947 `call T_F40A04` -- clear the destination (TrackMerge_Execute uses SongEdit_ClearTrack, 138889)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176973 `call T_BStore_AllocBlock_Veneer` -- new destination chain
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:176992 `calr sub_F72CBC` -- merge loop follows
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138855 `call T_F4280C` -- TrackMerge_Execute's part step this copy lacks

header:
Multi-track import, after every MTrk was merged into track 1: needs 17 free blocks (else (0x1238) := 0xFF); copies track 1's blocks through the 0x60A000 window, resets all 17 entries (sub_F7330A), gives each a fresh block (sub_F73566), writes the master track's default time signature, then appends each event to track = its MIDI channel, re-tagged (0xDn->0xD1, 0xEn->0xD2, 0xFn->0xD3 ...), beat marks and the end tag to all 17.
Smf_ReadMultiTrack runs it before Smf_ResetTrackAssignToIdentity. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:174831 `calr sub_F72F5C` -- Smf_ReadMultiTrack, after the per-chunk merges (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177632 `m_cp_mi16 MW24, BStore_FreeCount, 0x0011` -- 17 free blocks needed
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177637 `ld de, (6305025:24)` -- track 1's head block (entry 0 +1)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178220 `ldir85` -- sub_F7335A: 256 bytes of it into the 0x60A000 window
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177645 `calr sub_F7330A` -- entries 1..17 reset
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177651 `calr sub_F73566` -- fresh block per track (a copy of Smf_AllocFirstBlockForAllTracks)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177655 `call sub_F6FA70` -- default time signature on the master track
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177657 `calr sub_F7339C` -- next event from the window
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177702 `ld iy, (Smf_VlqValue:16)` -- note: track = status & 15 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177706 `calr sub_F73440` -- ... load that track's cursor ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177708 `calr sub_F73261` -- ... append BC event bytes ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177710 `calr sub_F73236` -- ... set its used bit ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177822 `ld (Smf_VlqValue:16), 209` -- channel pressure re-tagged 0xD1 (pitch bend 0xD2 at 177834, 0xFn 0xD3 at 177846)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:177681 `calr sub_F7328F` -- 0x81 / 0x82 to all 17 tracks

why_refused: Its used-track arm runs sub_F73664, which rewrites each used track's lead bytes in place (0x84->0x82, 0xD0..0xD3/0x80 -> MIDI statuses | (0x10CA), controller and program data patched) for a purpose not established beyond that; only the clear-unused-track arm is clear.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179085 `call sub_F735F7` -- Smf_WriteFile, before SmfExport_MergeUsedTracksIntoFirst (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178609 `jr c, sub_F735F7_Skip2` -- mask bit clear ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178633 `call T_F40A04` -- ... -> BStore_ClearTrack
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178624 `calr sub_F73664` -- used track -> the in-place rewrite
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178705 `calr BStore_WriteCursorByteNoSave` -- sub_F73664 writes into the song store
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:178725 `or a, (4298:16)` -- status | (0x10CA), the track index (7 for track 17)

header:
A := 0 when the 8 name bytes of MIDI-file list entry Disk_SelectedEntry (0x60A480 + 8*n) are all spaces (a free slot), else 0xFE.
Smf_WriteFile calls it when the file name is not in the list; non-zero sends the save to UI_ScreenPage 2, the pass that deletes the listed file before writing. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179021 `call sub_F74885` -- Smf_WriteFile (caller) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179022 `cp a, 0:i3` -- ... non-zero -> Smf_WriteFile_Skip58
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180400 `ld (UI_ScreenPage:16), 2` -- Skip58: page 2, then return
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179071 `call T_DiskApi_DeleteFile_Call` -- on page 2 the listed entry's .MID is deleted first
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180525 `ld a, (Disk_SelectedEntry:16)` -- entry n ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180523 `ld xix, 6333568` -- ... of the list at 0x60A480 (MidiFile_CountFileList's)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180530 `cp (xix+), 32` -- 8 spaces?
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180535 `ld a, 254:opc` -- else 0xFE

header:
Searches the 100 eight-byte names of the MIDI-file list at 0x60A480 for Disk_FileName's first 8 characters: found -> Disk_SelectedEntry := its index, W = 0xFF; else W = 0.
Smf_WriteFile's first check on a fresh save: a hit sends it to UI_ScreenPage 2, the pass that deletes that file before writing. Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179018 `calr sub_F748AD` -- Smf_WriteFile, unless already on page 2 (caller)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:179019 `cp w, 0:i3` -- found -> Smf_WriteFile_Skip58 (page 2)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180562 `ld xix, 6333568` -- list entry c at 0x60A480 + 8c
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180566 `ld xiy, Disk_FileName` -- compared with Disk_FileName
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180574 `cp l, 7:i3` -- 8 bytes
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180576 `ld (Disk_SelectedEntry:16), c` -- hit: Disk_SelectedEntry := c, W = 0xFF
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180581 `cp c, 99` -- 100 entries
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:180583 `xor w, w` -- miss: W = 0
